trechos.trecho: On both of the past two days I have started my anki reviews on my laptop and finished my cards on the ios app. Today when I opened my laptop anki I was prompted to conduct a full sync and it appears that I have lost all of the progress on the cards I have completed in the past two days and lost my review streak (544 days).
trechos.contexto: Reclamação de perda de dados após full sync

trechos.trecho: Ideally, I would like to rectify the review count on my laptop anki, preferably not lose the reviews I have done in the past two days, and hopefully fix my streak
On iOS: 1. Go to the deck list. 2. Tap the gear icon → Export → export all decks with scheduling (and media if offered), and save the .apkg file somewhere safe
trechos.contexto: Descrição de tarefa manual de backup

trechos.trecho: When the sync button is red, it will always ask whether you want to upload or download. If you want to force this prompt to appear, go to Preferences and enable One-Way Sync.
trechos.contexto: Descrição de tarefa manual para força sincronização
